# Muster documentation, version latest: Home, Guide, After

This file holds the full text of the pages outside any section. The index of the documentation is https://muster-io.github.io/muster/latest/llms.txt, and https://muster-io.github.io/muster/latest/llms-full.txt lists the files of the full text; the rules for AI agents are in https://muster-io.github.io/muster/latest/llms-full-guide.txt.

# Fixture

[site](https://muster-io.github.io/muster/latest/section/index.md "The section"), with **bold**. Not this sentence.
